To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
IS development methodologies are used as an organizational fiction to present an illusion of order and control, and that they do not reflect the actual process of IS development.
“IS development methodologies are treated as a necessary fiction, and are too simplistic to be of much practical value.”
“the fiction of methodology is a fiction of development, and the fiction of development is a fiction of methodology”.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the social and organizational context of IS development, and with the way in which this context shapes the process of IS development.
how people use and develop information systems.
understanding how IS development is organized and how it is accomplished.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the study found that traditional IS development methods are used primarily as a necessary and symbolic fiction to present an appearance of control and to provide a status symbol.

there is no single “correct” way to approach IS development, and that there may be no such thing as “methodological development” as a concept in the sense that it is currently understood in the IS field.
the methodology was used to provide an illusion of control and a status symbol, but that it was too mechanistic to actually be useful.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ISD process is not a linear, sequential, and rational process, and that ISD methodologies do not provide an effective framework to guide ISD.
we are attempting to understand the process of information system development in a large organisation.
the IS development process is not a simple linear sequence of activities, but a complex, dynamic process that is influenced by a wide range of organizational, technical, social and political factors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we should not be so quick to assume that the methods we are developing for IS development are actually being used.
the IS development methodologies are not used as intended, but rather as a necessary fiction.

ISD is a complex and messy process that is best understood through an ecological approach that emphasizes the interplay between the people, the tasks, and the tools that are involved in the process of IS development.
